svg.text: ▸ 3rd-year B.Tech CSE undergrad at GGSIPU specializing in Machine Learning engineering,
high-throughput backend architecture, and AI safety framework design.
▸ Passionate about building resilient, production-ready AI systems — from voice-first LLM copilots
(GallaSaathi) and intelligent conversational crime DBs (Datathon-2026) to neural network auditing (SANN).
▸ Core focus: PyTorch model fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT), neural safety & shortcut detection,
distributed FastAPI microservices, and decentralized Web3 application backends.
